IMP C C VIB TREB GALLVS AVG

A base silver, Roman, radiate of Trebonnius Gallus AD.251-253, Reece period 12, possibly mint of Rome. Obverse, radiate bust right, draped, legend: IMP C C VIB TREB GALLVS AVG. Reverse, Pax left, holding branch and sceptre across body, PAX AETERNA
